item.text: I’ll inspect the Python sanitizer and the quote oracle, make a focused implementation change, then run the requested test command.

The marker loop can advance past the end of a line and then slice at the new index. It also checks for triple quotes before checking whether an ordinary string is active. I’m fixing those two cases in the Python branch.
